The plugin is unchanged since 0.1.3; this release changes how it is built and published.

## What changed since 0.1.3

- **Built and attested by GitHub Actions.** The release's three files, `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css`, are now built from the tagged source by GitHub Actions and carry an artifact attestation of their build provenance. Check a downloaded file with `gh attestation verify main.js --repo Gameboard-dev/dictionary-and-synonyms`.

## Requirements and installation

As in 0.1.3: Obsidian 1.5.0 or later, desktop only. See the [README](https://github.com/Gameboard-dev/dictionary-and-synonyms#readme).
